prompt: elixir to_timeout Duration year month fields constraint
answer:
`to_timeout/1` requires a `Duration`’s `year` and `month` fields to be set to `0`. Durations with nonzero years or months cannot be reliably converted to milliseconds because months and years have varying numbers of days.

It supports durations only up to weeks; `:week`, `:day`, `:hour`, `:minute`, `:second`, `:millisecond`, and duration microseconds are supported.
